method: Ghidra decompilation and instruction listings of the identified executable. Name literals, StackOperator vftables, constants and the GetArguments_ literal were compared with the PE bytes through its section table. Addresses are virtual addresses.
scope: Static Lua call contracts for selected Control-class natives: declared argument and return StackOperator lists, owning native class, callback and forwarding target. Positions count post-receiver Lua arguments. Client-side contracts do not establish server behavior.

framework.registration: Each registrar builds a return-type list and an argument-type list, then calls a per-class wrapper that constructs the 0x58-byte functor through a constructor such as 0x00724C10. The argument list is stored at functor +0x14 and the return list at +0x24. The MemberFunctionHolder vftable installed by the holder constructor names the owning native class. 0x00CCCAD0 installs the functor under the name built by 0x00447260.

typeRegistry.tagRule: The 16-byte ExecuteParameters value tag at +0x0C equals the builtin registry index.
typeRegistry.composite: Which<...> lists are WhichStackOperator instances (0x00CCA470) appended through 0x00CCA2D0.

argumentMarshalling.perArgument: 0x00CFAA10 calls the declared StackOperator's slot 1, which consumes one Lua stack slot. The int, float, bool, Utf8String and Variable readers convert Lua nil to tag 6.
argumentMarshalling.missingArguments: Declared positions beyond the Lua stack top are filled with tag 6 by 0x00CFAA10 through 0x00583F70 without a stack read.
argumentMarshalling.extraArguments: When Lua arguments remain after the declared list, 0x00D19A20 pushes Component::Lua::GameEngine::Functor::GetArguments_ (0x0110F5B4) with line 0x9A and raises through 0x00CF38A0, which ends in 0x00DCEBC0.
argumentMarshalling.typedReaders: 0x005819A0 int tag 0, 0x0071BAC0 float tag 1, 0x0071BA00 bool tag 2, 0x0071CE70 string tag 3, 0x0071BEB0 LuaControl* tag 4. A mismatched tag reaches 0x00CCA730.

rows.behavior: Passes the control identity from ExecuteParameters +0x0C and the filename to 0x0075B730, which resolves the control through 0x004D9910 and calls 0x00533EF0 with the filename.
Assigns the filename to the CutScene object's string at +0x6C through 0x00447450. No load is started by this callback.
Assigns the filename to the SpreadSheet string at +0x60, passes that string to virtual slot 1 of the object returned by 0x0075F5A0, and stores the result at +0xB4.

Calls 0x0075B750, which resolves the control through 0x004D9910 and calls 0x00537D50. Replaces the object at WidgetBase +0x60 with a new 0x008951B0 instance, calls 0x00CC73E0, then yields the Lua thread through 0x00CD2860 and LuaThreadImpl::YieldLua 0x00CCD390 with a WaitLoadFormResumeChecker built by 0x00717510 from the control identity.

arguments.note: Optional leading name. Nil omits it.
Tag 0 int -> 0x006E9B80, tag 1 float -> 0x006F03C0, tag 2 bool -> 0x006E9CF0, tag 3 string -> 0x006E9E60, tag 4 LuaControl* -> 0x006E9FD0. Any other tag, including Nil, performs no update.

Reads a record through 0x006BFD20 and 0x006C2140, then switches on the selector. Selectors 0, 6, 7 and 0x10 through 0x13 push an int through 0x00584F70. Selectors 1 and 0x14 through 0x17 push a bool through 0x00748870. Selector 3 pushes a string built by 0x006BF830 through 0x007487C0. Other selectors push no value.

rows.behavior: 0x006F4910 writes literal @ (0x00FD4DC0) and argument 3 to a text stream, appends the parameters, wraps the text through 0x00716AC0 and calls 0x006E9AC0 with the same name routing as _setProperty.

ActorBaseClass returns true for any control. CharaBaseClass, PlayerBaseClass, NpcBaseClass, AreaBaseClass, DirectorBaseClass and DesktopWidget are tested with the RTTI cast 0x009DA6CC against the matching native class. Any other name is tested by 0x00CC7210 with the control and the name.

arguments.handlerRead: tag 6 substitutes the shared string at 0x01377E78, otherwise 0x0071CE70 tag 3

arguments.note: True enables the existing-control branch through 0x00CC7200 and 0x00CC7A00.

rows.behavior: The existing-control branch pushes the control at once when its initialization flag is set and otherwise yields. The creation branch calls virtual slot +0x6C at 0x00709A78 on the object from 0x00CC7A00, then yields. Both yields go through 0x00CD2860 with a Global::OnInitResumeChecker built by 0x00713FE0. Checker slot 0x007140C0 polls initialization. Slot 0x007493A0 pushes the control through 0x00748B30 on resume.

If argument 0 is Nil, passes the static value at 0x0130CF00 to 0x00CC7400. Otherwise scans arguments in order and stops at the first Nil. Each float f becomes the integer trunc(f * 10000.0 + 0.5) / 10 (constants 0x00FE0570 and 0x00F59898, signed division truncating toward zero), is wrapped by 0x00CD6AB0 and is passed to 0x00CC7400.
0x0078D520 converts the copied arguments through 0x00791030, invokes 0x00CD25F0 with the method name and pushes each result by its tag. The declared argument list holds one Variable after the name.
rows.conflict: docs/door-initialization-native-contract.md reads 0x0078D520 as preserving two trailing values for a three-argument call. The declared list admits one trailing value, and 0x00D19A20 raises GetArguments_ when Lua arguments remain. The two observations are unreconciled.

rows.behavior: Reads the focused identity through 0x0075BA10 with the control identity from ExecuteParameters +0x0C. Identity -0x40000000 pushes Nil. Otherwise the identity is resolved through 0x00CC9320 and 0x00CC7A50. A missing control pushes Nil and a resolved control is pushed as LuaControl*.

boundaries: Global natives _isInstanceOf and _createActor are documented by ExecuteParameters position. The receiver binding that maps a global Lua call onto those positions was not traced.
A declared return list states capacity. A handler may push fewer values.
These are client marshalling contracts. They do not establish widget layout, property names, or server behavior.
